note: Every entry marked actually_happened: true is a real failure from a private incident register or a project post-mortem, with its coordinates stripped — the shape of the mistake, never where it lives. If an invented entry is ever added it must be marked false. The site's whole premise is that the numbers and the stories are real; one fabrication labelled real would spend credit that cannot be earned back.
